name: Stupor
text: Revelation - Put Stupor into play in your threat area. Stupor can be healed as if it were a single point of horror on you (if it is healed, discard it). Forced - After you take a parley, draw, or investigate action: You cannot take any of those types of actions for the remainder of the turn.
text_cn: 显现 -将麻木放置入你的威胁区域。 麻木可被治愈，如同其为你身上的单独1点恐惧(如果它被治愈，则将其丢弃)。 强制 - 在你进行谈判、抽取或调查行动后：在该回合剩余时间内你不能再进行任何这些类型的行动。
